roles.title: Marketing Manager
roles.summary: Grow trovemart.co.uk from a new storefront into a shop people come back to — and keep our eBay store busy while we do it.
responsibilities: Own how TroveMart is found: SEO for the website, and titles and listings that rank on eBay
Write product descriptions that sound like a person, not a keyword list
Run our social channels and build a simple content routine we can actually keep up
Set up and test paid ads on a small budget, and stop what is not paying for itself
Watch the numbers — visitors, orders, what sells — and tell us plainly what they mean
Find ways to bring customers back, from email to repeat-buyer offers
requirements: Hands-on e-commerce marketing experience — a marketplace background (eBay, Amazon, Etsy) is a real plus
You know your way around SEO and can show work that moved rankings or sales
Comfortable writing copy yourself, not only briefing someone else
Happy working from data, and honest when something has not worked
Self-starting — this is a small team, so you will shape the plan as well as run it
Right to work in the UK
